storage.routes.applies: Plan: storage the code reads directly, routed through OneLake shortcuts

warehouse.collation.applies: Migrate: the Warehouse collation, set when it is created

names.warehouse.applies: Migrate and Validate: the Warehouse's name

operations.identity.applies: Execution plan: checks that the Fabric sign-in is this kind

security.migrate.applies: Migrate: whether the Roles & permissions stage is on

governance.residency.applies: Execution plan: a person checks the target capacity's region, and the agent starts no run until they have

validate.depth.applies: Validate: how deep it checks by default

cutover.parallelRun.applies: Execution plan: a task for each side-by-side cycle before cutover

cutover.parallelCycles.applies: Execution plan: how many side-by-side cycles

release.cutover.applies: People: the cutover window and what a rollback means

validate.externalWrites.applies: Validate: runs pipelines and notebooks only once a person says it is safe (K10)

context.timeline.applies: LLM drafts and people: the timeline

context.painPoints.applies: LLM drafts and people: what hurts today

context.consumers.applies: LLM drafts and people: what reads the data downstream

context.teamSkills.applies: LLM drafts and people: what the team knows best

pool.warehouseName.description: The Warehouse name the pool's name gives

source.ref.description: The Git branch or tag read

discovery.complete.description: Discovery read every part of the source

discovery.failedCategories.description: The parts of the source discovery could not read

target.capacity.description: The Fabric workspace is on a capacity

target.gitConnected.description: The Fabric workspace is connected to Git

llm.available.description: Claude Code is installed on this machine
